test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The State List contains the subjects of local importance. Which of the following falls under the State List?

options.text: Taxes on income other than agricultural income

solution:
The correct answer is__** Public health and sanitation.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Constitution** is a detailed document that addresses every aspect of national governance.
 
• The constitution also outlines how** the state and central governments' respective roles and responsibilities** are to be divided.
 
• The most significant section of the constitution in this regard is the **Seventh Schedule**.
 
• Three lists—**the Union List, State List, and Concurrent List**—are used to specify the roles and duties.
 
• **State List**
 
 
• The state list is a** list of 61 subjects** over which state legislatures have authority.
 
• This list includes important** regional and local issues that call for state-specific responses** as well as issues that allow for a range of interest.
 
• It outlines areas of jurisdiction, including those for **public order, prisons, **the production, manufacture, transport, purchase, and sale of alcoholic beverages,** public health and sanitation, agricultural education and research, fisheries, state public services**, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Union List**

 
 
• The Union List is a** list of 100 topics** over which the **Union or Center government** has exclusive authority.
 
• It is a list of issues of **national significance about which only the central government has the authority** to make judgments.
 
• It includes subjects of National Importance such as **banking, atomic energy, rail transportation, post, and foreign affairs**.
 
 
 
• **Concurrent List**
 
 
• There are **47 topics** on the concurrent list that are under the jurisdiction of both the **Union and the State legislatures**.
 
• The Indian Constitution adds topics like **population control, family planning, industrial and labour conflicts, forests, criminal law, criminal process, preventive detention, trade unions, and preservation of wild animals and birds** to the concurrent list.
